Introduction

The Quarterly Superannuation Product Statistics (QSPS) comprises statistics of products offered by APRA-regulated RSEs with more than six members that exist at the end of the quarter in the following tables: 
• Table 1a: Superannuation product structure and profile contains details of all superannuation products offered by APRA-regulated RSEs.
• Table 1b: Investment pathway structure and profile shows each investment pathway available through these products to an investment option, together with information about the investment option. This table excludes insurance only and risk only products. 
• Tables 4 through 7 show key metrics for each MySuper product, Choice products in the accumulation phase which are classified as trustee directed products or Multi Sector and Retirement products which are classified as trustee directed products or   multi-sector where the trustee controls investment option management or strategy setting. These tables exclude any options with zero members and assets:
•  Table 4: MySuper Net Returns 
• Table 5: Net Investment Returns (Choice Accumulation - Non-platform) 
• Table 6: Gross Investment Returns Net of Fees (Choice Accumulation - Platform) 
• Table 7: Investment Returns (Retirement). Investment Return (IR) generally gross investment return net of fees (gross of investment taxes and net of investment fees) for platform and net investment return for non-platform. Net return is gross of investment taxes for platform and net of investment taxes for non-platform.
• Table 8a: MySuper Investment Strategy
• Table 8b: Investment Strategy (Choice Accumulation - Non-platform)
• Table 8c: Investment Strategy (Choice Accumulation - Platform)
• Table 8d: Investment Strategy (Retirement)
• Table 9: Disclosed ongoing annual fees and costs for each MySuper product and multi-sector investment options offered through non-platform Choice products in the accumulation phase
• Table 10: Activity Fees for MySuper products and choice products
• Table 11: MySuper Administration fee levels (Allowable for employees of employer sponsors under s.29VB of the SIS Act - MySuper products)
